title: Source / medium and UTM tags
path: Reports > Life cycle > Acquisition > Traffic acquisition
steps: In the Google Merchandise Store property, open Reports > Life cycle > Acquisition > Traffic acquisition.
Set the date range to the month the app shows, from its first day to its last.
Change the table's first column to Session source / medium: choose it from the drop-down at the top of that column.
Sort the table by the Sessions column, highest first, by clicking its header.
Read the source / medium and the sessions in the first row below the totals row, then the sessions in the totals row at the top of the table.

parts.question: Which session source / medium has the most sessions in the month? Type it exactly as GA4 shows it, with a space on each side of the slash.

parts.label: Top row's sessions
parts.question: How many sessions does that row show?

parts.label: Total sessions
parts.question: How many sessions does the totals row show?
A Google Ads ad has auto-tagging switched on, and its link also carries utm_source and utm_medium. Which values does GA4 use for the session's source and medium?
options: The UTM values from the link
Neither: GA4 shows (not set) when the two disagree
The auto-tagged values from Google Ads
The UTM value for source and the auto-tagged value for medium
